newsitem.title: USA: First Union links provision to credit cards.
newsitem.headline: First Union links provision to credit cards.

text.p: First Union Corp. said on Monday it raised its third-quarter loan-loss provision mainly because of its credit card business.
"Card charge-offs were the overall driver" for allowances for possible bad debt, said Mal Murray, credit officer at First Union, which reported quarterly earnings earlier Monday.
The Charlotte, N.C.-based bank increased its provision for loan losses to $105 million from $60 million in the same period a year ago.
"Our loan-loss provision has stepped up a little over the last two years and will continue," Murray said.
